description: Set the organisation's company name and branding (same fields and same rule as Settings › Branding: tenant admins only; a key acts with its owner's role). Pass only the fields to change. company_name: non-empty, max 200 chars. logo_url: an https:// address of the logo image (no data: or base64 — upload the file elsewhere and pass its link), null or '' removes it. brand: 'callpilot' | 'delegaize'. primary_color / accent_color: hex like '#3b82f6', null or '' resets to the default. email_signature: max 2000 chars, null or '' clears it. Other branding settings are kept. Always changes the tenant you are working in; every change is written to the audit log with old and new value.

brand.description: Product brand for links and sender name in emails.

logo_url.description: https:// link to the logo; null or '' removes it.

name: update_tenant_branding
